resources.name: Shimeji API
resources.description: Public catalog, staff ingestion, health, and maintenance requests.

resources.name: 01 - Health
resources.description: Unauthenticated service probes.

resources.name: GET Health (liveness)
resources.description: Confirms that the application process is running; it performs no dependency checks.

resources.name: GET Ready (database and storage)
resources.description: Checks database and object storage readiness. A local development setup may report unconfigured storage.

resources.name: 02 - Public catalog
resources.description: All requests require a valid X-API-Key. Replace category_id and item_id after fetching real records.

resources.name: GET Manifest
resources.description: Bootstrap taxonomy: active content types, categories, subcategories, and counts.

resources.name: GET Categories (wallpaper)
resources.description: Lists active wallpaper categories. Change type to shimeji or battery as needed.

resources.name: GET Subcategories
resources.description: Lists active subcategories for category_id. Clear category_id and use ?type=wallpaper to list a type.

resources.name: GET Wallpapers (filtered)
resources.description: Wallpaper feed. Try category_id, media_type, is_live, tags, q, resolution, ordering, or updated_since filters.

resources.name: GET Wallpaper detail
resources.description: Returns one wallpaper. Set item_id from a wallpaper-feed result.

resources.name: GET Shimeji
resources.description: Paginated Shimeji feed.

resources.name: GET Shimeji detail
resources.description: Returns one Shimeji item. Set item_id from the Shimeji feed first.

resources.name: GET Battery
resources.description: Paginated battery-media feed.

resources.name: GET Battery detail
resources.description: Returns one battery item. Set item_id from the battery feed first.

resources.name: GET Mixed items
resources.description: Combined feed across types allowed by the API key.

resources.name: GET Mixed item detail
resources.description: Returns an allowed item regardless of its content type.

resources.name: GET Related items
resources.description: Returns other items in the same subcategory, or the same category where no subcategory exists.

resources.name: GET Wallpapers with ETag
resources.description: Conditional GET. Paste the ETag returned by a feed request into etag; a 304 response means nothing changed.

resources.name: 03 - Staff ingest
resources.description: Requires staff authentication. Set staff_jwt to a valid Bearer token, then use real IDs returned by earlier requests.

resources.name: POST Create upload slot
resources.description: Creates presigned B2 PUT slots. The filename, MIME type, and exact size must match the eventual upload.

resources.name: POST Commit uploaded file
resources.description: Validates the uploaded bytes and creates media items. Set asset_ticket_id only after completing the direct B2 PUT.

resources.name: POST Abort upload slots
resources.description: Cancels unused upload tickets and removes any uploaded bytes.

resources.name: PATCH Media item
resources.description: Updates editorial fields only; storage details and computed values cannot be changed.

resources.name: DELETE Media item (archive)
resources.description: Archives an item (soft delete). Stored bytes are purged later by the orphan reaper.

resources.name: 04 - Internal maintenance
resources.description: Use only from a trusted scheduler or for supervised operations.

resources.name: POST Reap orphans (dry run)
resources.description: Reports abandoned upload tickets and expired archived media without deleting anything. Remove dry_run=1 to perform cleanup.

resources.name: POST Reconcile counts (dry run)
resources.description: Reports category/subcategory count corrections without persisting them. Remove dry_run=1 to reconcile counts.
